```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="desk">

  <!-- ==============================
       Parameters (all in metres)
       Width (X)  : 1.29
       Height (Z) : 0.71
       Depth (Y)  : 0.61
       ============================== -->

  <!-- ==============================
       Link: desk_top (the main tabletop)
       ============================== -->
  <link name="desk_top">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.29 0.61 0.10"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.29 0.61 0.10"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="15.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.65" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.45" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.55" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.30"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==============================
       Links: four legs (fixed to desk_top)
       ============================== -->
  <!-- Leg dimensions: 0.05 x 0.05 cross‑section, height 0.61 m (top to floor) -->
  <link name="leg_front_left">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.62 0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal">
        <color rgba="0.7 0.7 0.7 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.62 0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <origin xyz="-0.62 0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.005" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.005" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.001"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_front_right">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.62 0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.62 0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0.62 0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.005" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.005" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.001"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_back_left">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.62 -0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.62 -0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <origin xyz="-0.62 -0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.005" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.005" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.001"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_back_right">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.62 -0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.62 -0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.05 0.05 0.61"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0.62 -0.28 -0.305" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.005" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.005" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.001"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==============================
       Link: drawer (slides out toward -Y)
       ============================== -->
  <link name="drawer">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.20 0.45 0.30"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.20 0.45 0.30"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.20" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.25" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.15"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==============================
       Joints
       ============================== -->
  <!-- Fixed joints for legs -->
  <joint name="top_to_front_left_leg" type="fixed">
    <parent link="desk_top"/>
    <child link="leg_front_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.62 0.28 -0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="top_to_front_right_leg" type="fixed">
    <parent link="desk_top"/>
    <child link="leg_front_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.62 0.28 -0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="top_to_back_left_leg" type="fixed">
    <parent link="desk_top"/>
    <child link="leg_back_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.62 -0.28 -0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="top_to_back_right_leg" type="fixed">
    <parent link="desk_top"/>
    <child link="leg_back_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.62 -0.28 -0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Prismatic joint for drawer -->
  <joint name="drawer_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="desk_top"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0.05 0.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.30" effort="100" velocity="0.2"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
